_comment: One entry per field. 'key' is the bridge's internal id; 'helios_field_key' is the field_key in Jacob's Helios account (his account uses field-1..field-4). 'irrocloud_device_name' and 'irrocloud_device_id' are the device exactly as the IrroCloud site shows it (mapped from the real site on 2026-08-24 — see discovery/REPORT.md). 'probes' maps probe letter to role: 'pivot' (under the pivot; used for the headline numbers) or 'handline'. On the real site the handline sensors turned out to be SEPARATE DEVICES ('SB Bennett 1 N HLS', 'SB Whitted SS') which the bridge does not fetch, so every probe on the pivot devices is pivot. 'trigger_cb' is Jacob's irrigation trigger number in centibars; REPLACE_ME uses a placeholder of 50 and says so in every email.

fields.name: Bennett 1 N
fields.probes_note: The handline sensors ('HLS') are a separate IrroCloud device (SB Bennett 1 N HLS, id 1355) that the bridge does not fetch, so all probes here are pivot.

fields.name: Whitted
fields.probes_note: The solid-set handline sensors ('SS') are a separate IrroCloud device (SB Whitted SS, id 2254) that the bridge does not fetch, so all probes here are pivot.
